subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start contract should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start plus provider/model-routing semantics, so automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Add a typed policy that keeps defaults explicit and covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing without separate competing knobs.

options.title: Restore Startup Turns By Default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and intentionally accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only Defaults
options.body: Keep static acknowledgements as the default and make any greeting/model run an explicit opt-in policy.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Add a typed policy that keeps defaults explicit and covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing without separate competing knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current bare reset acknowledgement contract and prior policy review, making it the best available owner for the default/config decision.
